function.name: image_search
function.description: Search for images on the web. Use this when the user asks to see, find, or show images of something.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for current information, news, or facts. Use this when the user asks about recent events, people, places, or anything you are uncertain about.

function.name: fetch_url
function.description: Fetch the text content of a public web page. Only use this to read a specific URL the user has provided or that appeared in search results.
